open_issues.text: I split creation into two commands, init (code only, risk-based) and init-remote (code + remote, always, risk high), instead of one init with an optional remote field. Binding a remote is a network action that connect already guards with `always`; one command with an optional field could not have a conditional confirmation.

open_issues.impact: If the owner meant another command, a form must be added.
open_issues.text: 'Bind a checkout' is project-attach (existing marker/new project, binds here) plus project-rebind (replace the binding by another checkout of the project) and project-scan. I added no separate bind command because the workspace CLI has none; the goal text does not name one.

summary: GUI forms for the workspace commands, added as gui.json commands of bridges/gui-workspace, which the host renders from their inputs. New commands: init-remote (create a workspace bound to an empty remote, confirmation always), project-add (path, name?, code?) and project-remove (empty project only, confirmation always). The existing init, connect, project-attach (now titled 'Bind a checkout') and project-rebind stay; routes Overview and Projects list the forms. run.py got three verbs with value checks, with tests in test_commands.py and test_queries.py (a real-CLI scenario). New e2e scenarios in workspace.spec.ts cover connect, create, create-on-remote, add, rebind and remove. Docs and changelog updated. The e2e spec could not be run in the sandbox.
